title: Magi Mirrou
description: Use magic mirror to teleport to your home!
body: # Magi Mirrou ![](https://github.com/aratakileo/magi-mirrou/blob/main/preview/crafts.png?raw=true) This mod adds two types of magic mirrors that allow you to return to the player's spawn location. Depending on the type of magic mirror, you can use them in different dimensions. After each teleportation, the player takes damage to half a heart, as well as the item goes into a small cooldown. The textures of this mod were created based on textures from the [Magic Mirrors](https://modrinth.com/mod/qds-magic-mirror) mod. ![](https://github.com/aratakileo/magi-mirrou/blob/main/preview/gameplay1.gif?raw=true) ![](https://github.com/aratakileo/magi-mirrou/blob/main/preview/gameplay2.gif?raw=true) ![](https://github.com/aratakileo/magi-mirrou/blob/main/preview/gameplay3.gif?raw=true)
